name: The Continuity Foundation
public: Charity restoring damaged DHFs and supplying sleeves to victims.
goal: Commercialise editable continuity for wealthy and state clients.

name: Protectorate Continuity Office
public: Stack evidence, state resleeving and continuity-crimes authority.
secret: Its sealed order placed the PCs on ice; present officers are divided over disclosure.
goal: Control legal continuity and the institutional consequences of the 2274 order.

name: Sable Needle Corporation
public: Needlecast relays, clone storage and secure DHF transmission.
secret: Moved fragments of the 2274 evidence and retains technical records.
goal: Protect its infrastructure and surviving records.

name: Blue Lotus Combine
public: Criminal network around sleeves and identity services.
secret: Long history of illegal sleeves, identity laundering, stacks, backups and witness disappearance.
goal: Profit while avoiding ownership by Palimpsest.

name: The Quiet Archive
public: Neo-C organisation recording testimony without spinning up the dead.
secret: Preserved analogue evidence resistant to memory tampering.

name: The Chainbreakers
secret: Some members want Palimpsest repurposed to erase obedience conditioning.
goal: Break Protectorate and Meth control without becoming a new continuity tyranny.
